title: 10% Triton X-100
author: Allen Institute for Brain Science

steps_raw.instruction: Scope: 10% Triton X-100 is utilized in several Immunohistochemistry (IHC) reagents to reduce the surface tension of the reagents and to make the cell membranes of the tissue more permeable.
Triton X-100 (VWR VW3929-2 or equivalent)
Labeled RNase-free 1 liter container.
Sterile 50 ml serological pipette.
Magnetic stir bar remover.
1 Liter graduated cylinder
10% Triton X-100 stock solution for use in IHC reagents.

Warning: This protocol is extremely sensitive to RNase contamination; ensure that you have been properly trained using sterile techniques before starting this protocol. Personal Protective Equipment () should be used at all times while operating this protocol. If you are unsure what you should be using, see your immediate supervisor.
Obtain an RNase free 1 liter container and an RNase free stir bar.
Methodology (record all lot numbers and volumes used in the appropriate reagent preparation notebook):
Using a graduated cylinder, measure 900 ml of MilliQ water into an RNase free 1 liter bottle containing an RNase free stir bar.
Add 100 ml of Triton X-100 to the 900 ml of MilliQ water.
Mix thoroughly by stirring on a stir plate with a setting of 5 or higher (around 15 minutes, or until dissolved).
Remove the stir bar from the bottle using a magnetic stir bar remover and wrap the bottle in foil. Label with reagent name, date, and the initials of the person preparing the solution.
Technical Information:
Final solution should not be exposed to light (foil wrapped) and stored room temperature for up to 12 weeks.
10% Triton X-100 expires after 12 weeks.

Triton X-100, when added to aqueous solutions acts as a surfactant, decreasing the surface tension of the solution. It also punches holes in membranes, allowing easier penetration of macrmolecules into cells and organelles, and reduces non-specific binding of antisera in immunohistochemistry.
Place empty container in plastic recycling bin.
10% Triton X-100 may be disposed of directly down any sink and into the municipal sewer system.
